script:
Three weeks after my diet ended, I stepped on the scale on a Tuesday morning, and the number was back. Same jeans, same mirror — and I had no idea how it happened so fast.

That Tuesday I opened my food diary for the first time since the diet. Nothing looked dramatic — but the portions had crept back. One extra spoon of rice at dinner, a handful of nuts while I cooked.

So that night I put the measuring cup back on the counter. Same plate, same portions, every night this week. Save this for your week three — that's when it matters most.
